stories.headline: Democrats hold both chambers as the count goes on in Alaska, Mississippi and about 60 House races
stories.deck: A day after AP race calls gave Democrats control of the House and the Senate, two Senate races and roughly 60 House seats were still uncalled on Wednesday. The open races will set the size of the new majorities, not which party leads.
stories.summary: A day after AP race calls gave Democrats control of the House and the Senate, two Senate races and roughly 60 House seats were still uncalled on Wednesday. The open races will set the size of the new majorities, not which party leads. NPR, using AP race calls, reported that Democrats flipped seven Republican-held Senate seats (North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Kansas, Iowa and Maine), returning them to full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. AP said that as of 4 p.m. ET Wednesday only a handful of Senate and governor races were uncalled and that 59 House races remained uncalled. El Cronista, citing AP tallies from Wednesday morning, put the Senate at 54 Democrats to 44 Republicans with Alaska and Mississippi still open. Slate reported on Wednesday evening that Democrats had officially won 237 House seats, with several Arizona, Florida, North Carolina and Colorado races among those still counting. California alone had 11 uncalled House seats, and its counties have until Dec. 3 to finish counting, El Cronista reported. Race-by-race results are in our Midterms 2026 special edition, listed under Past editions.
stories.why: Every extra seat changes how much room Democratic leaders have to pass bills, launch investigations and override, or fail to override, presidential vetoes when the new Congress meets in January.

stories.note: Seat totals move as ballots are counted; figures here are as of the times the linked outlets published them on Wednesday. Donna Daily does not call any race.

On Oct 28, U.S. District Judge David Carter refused a temporary order, writing that voters must not lose a core right 'because of unfounded allegations stemming from a procedure rife with uncertainty and errors'. A divided 9th Circuit panel (2-1) also refused on Friday, Oct 30. Solicitor General D. John Sauer then asked the justices on Monday morning to order the ballots kept apart, arguing that once they are mixed in 'there is no way to get the challenged ballots back'. NPR and AP reported Monday evening that the court had denied the request.

stories.headline: Alberta's elections chief says: keep the old riding map or delay the 2027 vote

A contested boundary report is due in the legislature Monday. NDP Leader Naheed Nenshi says the proposed map gerrymanders Calgary and Lethbridge and vows a court challenge; Premier Danielle Smith denies manipulating the vote. In Frankfurt, rioters later damaged 17 shops and looted five, attacking police with stones, fireworks and petrol bombs. Police arrested 54 people aged 13 to 29; more than 100 officers were injured. Hesse's interior minister said most suspects were German nationals but many had immigrant backgrounds; the city's mayor said passports don't matter, only accountability.
